app.name: SocialPrune
start.description: Go through your old X posts and Instagram comments, decide what should go, and get a list to delete it on the platform yourself.
start.privacy: SocialPrune reads your export in this browser. It has no server that could receive it.
gate.unavailable.title: This window cannot open real exports
gate.unavailable.body: SocialPrune opens an export only when it can block network access for the code that reads it, and this window does not allow that. Some private windows do this. Open SocialPrune in a normal window, or use the command line version. The demo works here.
gate.framed.title: Open SocialPrune directly
gate.framed.body: SocialPrune opens exports only when it is not embedded in another page. Open socialprune.github.io/socialprune directly.
guide.pending.body: The export steps have not been checked yet. No platform instructions are shown until that check is complete.
demo.banner: Demo with invented posts. The suggestions are examples written for this demo. No classifier produced them.
demo.pending: The review demo comes with the next part of this app. You can already check the app's offline and language settings.
import.parts: You can choose several files if your export came in parts.
import.check: Your export stays on this device. Want to check? Turn off your Wi-Fi now. SocialPrune keeps working.
import.reading: Reading your export... {count, number} {count, plural, one {entry} other {entries}} so far.
import.complete: {count, number} {count, plural, one {entry received} other {entries received}}.
import.cancelled: The import was cancelled. Its partial entries were discarded.
import.error: The archive could not be read. Choose another export and try again.
settings.foundation: Workspace settings arrive with the review. Language and appearance apply to this browser now.
privacy.read: SocialPrune reads the ZIP files you choose on this device. It does not send export data to a server.
privacy.network: Your browser loads this app from GitHub Pages. GitHub Pages logs visitors' IP addresses. Loading the app is network traffic; export content is not sent.
privacy.storage: Browser storage can be cleared. Another site under the same socialprune.github.io origin would share its storage. Keep a backup when the review becomes available.
privacy.agent: With the command line version, you may choose to share entries with an agent. Their full text then goes to that agent's model provider. Software running as your computer's user is outside what SocialPrune can control.
update.ready: A new version of SocialPrune is ready.
update.failed: The update could not start because a tab has not finished its work. Try again after the import stops.
